## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed or feature implemented.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code quality / Refactoring

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] Formatted with `cargo fmt --all`
- [ ] Tested with `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --all-features`
- [ ] Verified with `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- [ ] All tests pass via `cargo test --workspace --all-targets`
- [ ] Documentation updated if relevant
